message: キッカケ作りは難しい

name: Synn
message: 「What is this warm, fuzzy feeling? It's autumn, yet there's a springtime warmth drifting through the air.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's gotta be because of those cute little snaggleteeth.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Na-na-cha~n! Let's ha-ang ou-ut♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gaaah--! That's so embarrassing, geez! Just shut up and come inside!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Excuse me for intruding~」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin at Yuugiri-an? Is the Sweets Club having a strategy meeting?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, Synn's with you too?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hieeen, how long have you been there, Synn-kun~? Don't tell me you came here to freeload a meal~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's your line, Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehehe~, I'm in my growing phase, so I'll be in your care~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For someone in a growing phase, you sure haven't grown much, have you?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Gah-stab--!! That's uncalled for~, my naive maiden heart has been wounded deeper than the ocean~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Since it's come to this, it's stress-eating mode~. Chaaarge~」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka. I just happened to be passing by. See ya, good luck with the club.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Wait, don't go. Actually, this is good timing. I wanted to ask your advice too, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Asking for advice... Don't be a stranger, we're closer than that, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「If my milk is good enough for you, whether it's five liters or six liters, anytime, anywhere, as much as you want--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up! Just get inside already!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it really okay for me to come in during business hours?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know full well it's dead around this time on weekdays.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm, hmm. Mmm... What should I treat myself to~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't overthink it, just order whatever pops into your head.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? You're ordering off the Yuugiri-an menu?」

name: Synn
message: 「I totally thought we'd be bringing sweets in here for our club activities.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even I wouldn't do something that rude~ This is a restaurant, you know~? Gotta show some restraint~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well then~, mind if I make a quick order~? I wanna eat a 'Large Tempura Kitsune Wakame Chikara Soba'~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Show a little restraint, why don'tcha!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is what I'd like to say, but today's a special occasion, okay?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yahoo~! You're so generous, Nana-chan~, just what I'd expect from our president~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Pops, one 'Large Tempura Kitsune Wakame Chikara Soba' and one 'Kake Soba'!」
Nanaka calls the order back to the kitchen.

name: Synn
message: 「So my order just gets decided for me automatically, huh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ehehe, we gotta balance things out to offset the cost. I'll splurge for you on morning soba next time to make up for it!」
While her old man makes the soba, Nanaka comes over to consult with me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know that girl who was trying to talk to Lolo-chan earlier?」

name: Synn
message: 「Her name was Amyrina, if I remember right.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, that's her!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan and Emi-chan are giving off major awkward vibes right now, but I think they're actually really close.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, Lolotte even calls her by her name without any honorifics. They must be pretty close.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, it kinda seems like they're in the middle of a cold war right now, doesn't it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's between friends, so it's not really our place to butt in, but I still want them to make up.」

name: Synn
message: 「They probably just can't find the right opening to talk.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In times like that, delicious food is the answer!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How about we invite those two to Yuugiri-an and treat 'em to a feast?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a great idea. Conversation always flows easier over good food.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right, right?! Especially for Lolo-chan, it's guaranteed to work!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, but Lolotte's favorite foods are things like hamburg steak and Western dishes, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, well, that's where the Sweets Club vice-captain makes her grand entrance.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I get the feeling Lolo-chan's taste buds are pretty close to Sacchin's.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah! I see, I see!! Makes total sense, total sense!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Why are you nodding so hard, Synn-kun?」
While they were chatting away, the soba arrived.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Thanks for the food~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin, I always tell you--eat more slowly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, so you come here to eat sometimes?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「More like I'm the one inviting her along, I guess?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Only the folks in the shopping district know this, but Sacchin's basically a beckoning cat that's always a beat behind.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nyaooown♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Sacchin gives off the exact vibe of a cat snoozing away in a sunny spot.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe~」

name: Paqy
message: 「...They ain't complimenting you, y'know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whenever Sacchin stops by, that shop gets flooded with customers and business booms.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, like some kind of god of fortune--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's the truth!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then if Sacchin walked through the whole shopping district, wouldn't something crazy happen.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No... Sacchin only ever goes into shops she likes. She won't even go near places with sneaky people or mean shopkeepers.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, now that you mention it, she does drop a sharp comeback once in a blue moon, so maybe Sacchin really is a living god of good fortune...」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you think, Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Has nothing to do with Re-Crea. That's outside my jurisdiction.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh-hohohoho, worship me-- In a way, I can go toe-to-toe with the enshrined deity of Asukai Shrine, you know~」

name: Synn
message: 「...Lying is bad, Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「W-What's your proof--?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because the Sweets Club you're vice-president of hasn't gotten any members at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, what!? N-Now that you mention it, that's true.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「The Sweets Club will always be just the two of us~. 'Cause I want Nana-chan all to myself~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chaaan, squish♪ Boing~, rub-rub-rub~\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't get all overly clingy on me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And besides, it's not just the two of us.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yumil's there too, ya know?」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yuugiri-senpai... you don't have to bring me up like an afterthought...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tehehehehe.」
Regardless of whether Sacchin was born under a lucky star, I was deeply moved by Nanaka's thoughtfulness.
Even more than me, the president, she truly watches over Lolotte. And she doesn't just watch--she never slacks off when it comes to preparing to take action.
I need to follow her example...!
